Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 233, "heading": "IV APPARITION À MARIUS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u233-r0030", "target": "Она посмотрела Мариусу прямо в белки глаз и сказала ему:", "source_sha256": "2c168075a1ce3981126568056ec2aede006c8a0e28379d84df53b3ac827e72ef", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u233-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "fb7df52563109c73400ece81a9d4238d134617e18f14d81469177bba46cb4318"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u233-r0031", "target": "— У меня есть адрес.", "source_sha256": "f4792a77afa504330c5603283dd6ef2dd689fd6381a8f4c1033a69c8d6b3c753", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u233-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "f589957b1a8c95fb0571e8320961f98cd84dc850d64451cf1632d6c9cdb6dfda"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 4, "book": 2, "chapter": 4, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u233-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius pâlit. Tout son sang reflua à son cœur.", "sha256": "5c5e9d85745239550df828c8809e7ca11756728c9c48147baee845cc7a80492b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quelle adresse ?", "sha256": "671ef0c96fe7123e5d1f1253cca2a68737dfcd1ba4bcf47f9027c25d93f8e596", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "— L’adresse que vous m’avez demandée !", "sha256": "cb69f5327af8f5ee587f21db0075de7c980647ada0bdad59e09df05343e8d879", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "Elle ajouta comme si elle faisait effort :", "sha256": "4b695fb88f68be2ffae2fdcacfbc686311bf90fc376c4b11ed96a8429b552c44", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "— L’adresse… vous savez bien ?", "sha256": "1b689dd6edf8a3e17a161fa802b5bc302ab248b4bf279769aa5bec4e0464dc02", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui ! bégaya Marius.", "sha256": "756759e2fa943b78dc5f5be1a3ca205ffd55c554cebb9c277a8389fb2d63315f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "— De la demoiselle !", "sha256": "f20445143666c27011250e94dd5ff38e2b9dbc6c64aef69918d04795cdc0fb73", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ce mot prononcé, elle soupira profondément.", "sha256": "621a000e18ce85cb6e5255fb462025d91c0bb2bade5907680210959c8461e74a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius sauta du parapet où il était assis et lui prit éperdument la main.", "sha256": "bcd3f119d3d05a312fb1430a36478ef5140271282e02f96d76b445920f790707", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oh ! eh bien ! conduis-moi ! dis-moi ! demande-moi tout ce que tu voudras ! Où est-ce ?", "sha256": "10d978ca36df1d16c7b440c4cdec52fbdc4240d329ae4bc8892567ccbc33da73", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Venez avec moi, répondit-elle. Je ne sais pas bien la rue et le numéro ; c’est tout de l’autre côté d’ici, mais je connais bien la maison, je vais vous conduire.", "sha256": "5519b2bd0789b77f4ff2fe506c96e3ea83afba5d78dd02c56cd8b531b86a2714", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "Elle retira sa main et reprit, d’un ton qui eût navré un observateur, mais qui n’effleura même pas Marius ivre et transporté :", "sha256": "a77cf94da6b1c8d0a91ef27cd9e69bacf5b5153dc31012a0f49c09d45f31f5ac", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oh ! comme vous êtes content !", "sha256": "26dc03280162217e26cb59918638188b10bfab3c44b25c235c7514e09a98ed50", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "Un nuage passa sur le front de Marius. Il saisit Éponine par le bras.", "sha256": "9ea963a1d2a8032b43781da68cfc235f092174c06b4708b87f809a512decac0f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Jure-moi une chose !", "sha256": "ad82e25502fe8fd07fc023d2c40a31a828e5659effdb2fcc40436eba845814af", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Jurer ? dit-elle, qu’est-ce que cela veut dire ? Tiens ! vous voulez que je jure ?", "sha256": "1995260dbe647c540a24b36b95cfb788942dedb9a9fc7daafebd1d79297d88f0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et elle rit.", "sha256": "f4013df8321b51f59ce2f67a18039d3a46f4668bbc1bd230a6bb13d97f9603b7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ton père ! promets-moi, Éponine ! jure-moi que tu ne diras pas cette adresse à ton père !", "sha256": "b96321749cd23d412a494043916d55727aa5390296f82022db98ecd57ed80e9c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "Elle se tourna vers lui d’un air stupéfait.", "sha256": "f4d89f1d1db30c6a3990cea652c7fd460628d3c07384ea4f3b7b5af2bbbcc3ea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Éponine ! Comment savez-vous que je m’appelle Éponine ?", "sha256": "1caca507aa9a88c9bbc9fe962f852270248c460d8eecceaa53dd24a0981d1105", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Promets-moi ce que je te dis !", "sha256": "342965d2a19dc2675c2365a88f8f0c62de3e83e4b4b7c1069a32381b0d0802c9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "Mais elle semblait ne pas l’entendre.", "sha256": "bef99b9e3dfb60dfcadc58f36aef0dd3143e1434ba4e7b6a5cc01b2b5596045a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est gentil ça ! vous m’avez appelée Éponine !", "sha256": "cc08b2baac2cc2d38202ce818c0b7a65d5f1f2e7e051b846fda8f427ec16ee19", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius lui prit les deux bras à la fois.", "sha256": "31c2bb1fd5dbb382c693a0cf463e75643ed650a4d86963eaf00bab1f4f49c48e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais réponds-moi donc, au nom du ciel ! fais attention à ce que je te dis, jure-moi que tu ne diras pas l’adresse que tu sais à ton père !", "sha256": "f09873c3e0f10c21ec4a841d9fad82cd0c485112c90da86e06fc002d748435e4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mon père ? dit-elle. Ah oui, mon père ! Soyez donc tranquille. Il est au secret. D’ailleurs est-ce que je m’occupe de mon père !", "sha256": "a3cbf13c560bec3aa7ab8918e59add639aeddb69ea0f3145cd1a3de54eea21d9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais tu ne me promets pas ! s’écria Marius.", "sha256": "870328aa65333e51c4b901c7ae26a2118f6b7efbd91751837352a060925b5a6b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais lâchez-moi donc ! dit-elle en éclatant de rire, comme vous me secouez ! Si ! si ! je vous promets ça ! je vous jure ça ! qu’est-ce que cela me fait ? je ne dirai pas l’adresse à mon père. Là ! ça va-t-il ? c’est-il ça ?", "sha256": "9ab07f7becfb536db594c05aa751828ae23e66e6eef623babac370ae814d40e4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ni à personne ? fit Marius.", "sha256": "ac9d6e5a17fd34a9f797f0f6c7e6709feaadcda75c45bb16de0afe1d1f1b2c0e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ni à personne.", "sha256": "76393b00712a1846be2593e7451a076fa3701b136e12a4d3e9d6e602c887d077", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À présent, reprit Marius, conduis-moi.", "sha256": "ec6361877034109414c2e3d919f2fbbdd511e150044ddb3811e3094e31107fc0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u233-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tout de suite ?", "sha256": "a1162624d33b223baba538c3397309fbb4152a8bd27c1583e1e8b67f64cfd8c7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
